rows.observation: Repository identity casefolding, packet spelling, declared activities/testing goals and bounded repository portfolio inspected.
Plan/admission/evidence hashes, typed activity outputs, exact model route and gateway candidate binding inspected; execution omission is denied by downstream selectedReview.
Bounded language roots, rule forms, files/layers, known manifest scope and canonical allowed pairs inspected.
UTF8 bytes and Git blob identity, immutable packet/evidence and before-retention privacy classification inspected. No semantic truth inferred from hashes.
Exact byte citation validation, lane digest and assessment projection inspected. Empty assessments valid, absent source remains incomplete.
Partial privacy review retains omitted paths and separate execution/source completion; four lanes required.
Identity, failure and lane checks inspected; v3 delegates stricter assessment validation.
Native ordering helper only applied to validated review objects, preserving confidence variants.
Requires complete enclosing cycle with bound execution and native review, does not fabricate legacy top-level review identity.

limits: Browser UI and per-test manual review are separate; full suite executed, not every test manually reviewed.
